ayahs.arabic: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: And Lut, when he said to his people, 'Do you commit an immorality that no one in the worlds has ever done before you?'

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ النِّسَاءِ ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ
ayahs.translation_en: 'Indeed, you approach men with desire instead of women. Rather, you are a transgressing people.'
'Do you approach males among the worlds?'

ayahs.arabic: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.translation_en: And Lut, when he said to his people, 'Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?'

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا أَخْرِجُوهُم مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
ayahs.translation_en: But the answer of his people was only that they said, 'Evict them from your city! Indeed, they are men who keep themselves pure.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَا لُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: They said, 'If you do not desist, O Lut, you will surely be of those evicted.'

ayahs.arabic: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ السَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ الْمُنكَرَ
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings every evil.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَا أَعْيُنَهُمْ
ayahs.translation_en: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا سَلَامًا
ayahs.translation_en: And certainly did Our messengers come to Ibrahim with good tidings; they said, 'Peace.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَىٰ أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً
ayahs.translation_en: But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension.

ayahs.arabic: يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَا ۖ إِنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَإِنَّهُمْ آتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ
ayahs.translation_en: O Ibrahim, turn away from this. Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا
ayahs.translation_en: And when Our messengers came to Lut, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا يَا لُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوا إِلَيْكَ ۖ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ
ayahs.translation_en: They said, 'O Lut, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; they will not reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
ayahs.translation_en: So when Our command came, We made the highest part of it the lowest and rained upon it stones of layered hard clay.

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
ayahs.translation_en: And We made the highest part of it the lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; she was of those who remained behind.
